dataset_name: Bloxorz independently designed fixed benchmark test set
selection_method: 100 unique independently generated 13x17 board layouts plus the 20 GUI levels from levels/ (case_id GUI-xxx). Each case embeds its complete board definition and canonical initial state, so benchmark runs never read levels/. All cases were solved and validated with BFS before inclusion; fixed JSON is shared by every algorithm.

group_definitions.basic: No fragile, bridge, or switch tiles; branchy random terrain.
group_definitions.fragile: Basic terrain plus fragile tiles placed outside the accepted baseline solution path.
group_definitions.switches_bridges: A soft switch opens a bridge that starts closed; the resulting board is re-solved before acceptance.
group_definitions.combined: Fragile tiles plus a soft switch opening a closed bridge.
group_definitions.advanced_switches: Heavy and/or split switches, with any mix of fragile tiles, bridges and soft switches. Only GUI levels use these mechanics.

design_constraints.difficulty: Approximate strata based on verified BFS reference solution length: easy <22, medium 22-31, hard >=32. This is a proxy, not a universal measure of search difficulty.
design_constraints.reproducibility: The committed JSON is the fixed test set; generation seed is not needed to reproduce benchmark runs.
design_constraints.gui_cases: GUI levels are embedded as-is (all mechanics, including heavy and split switches). Group is assigned by mechanics present on the board: levels with heavy or split switches go to advanced_switches, the rest use the four independent groups. GUI levels are not filtered by the minimum length/expanded-node constraints above, and their fragile tiles may lie on the solution path.
